newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu, McDonnell to form software venture July 1.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu, McDonnell to form software venture July 1.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd and McDonnell Information Systems of Britain will jointly establish software development company Glovia International on July 1, the two companies announced on Thursday.
Glovia will develop, market and support client server application software to enable organisations to more effectively manage their supply operations, the companies said in a statement.
The new firm, to be formed in Los Angeles, will be owned 69.5 percent by the British company and the remaining 30.5 percent by Fujitsu.
Fujitsu will contribute $29 million in cash, while the British company will contribute assets, a Fujitsu spokesman said.
Fujitsu has sold Glovia brand package software, which supports finance, human resources and payroll, production control and sale management, since June, mainly in Japan and other Asian countries.
